import pathlib

# settings.py: rename the def only
p = pathlib.Path("settings.py")
t = p.read_text()
t = t.replace("def get_conf(", "def load_settings(")
p.write_text(t)

# all svc_*.py: replace every occurrence of get_conf
for f in sorted(pathlib.Path(".").glob("svc_*.py")):
    t = f.read_text()
    t = t.replace("get_conf", "load_settings")
    f.write_text(t)

print("done")
EOF"}
